'''Uxie''' (Japanese: '''ユクシー''' ''Yuxie'') is a [[non-player character]] in {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness}} and {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky}}. He is responsible for guarding the [[Time Gear]] in [[Fogbound Lake]].

Like all members of their species, Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf are treated as [[gender unknown]] for gameplay purposes; however, Uxie and Azelf are addressed with masculine pronouns in dialogue, while Mesprit is addressed with feminine pronouns.

==In the games==
===History===
====[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness|Explorers of Time, Darkness]] and [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky|Sky]]====
Uxie is mentioned once the {{player}}, their partner, and Bidoof reach base camp. A legend about Fogbound Lake and Uxie's ability to erase memories is told, leading the player to believe that Uxie was the cause for their amnesia.

When both the {{pkmn2|hero}} and their {{mdc|partner Pokémon}} reach Fogbound Lake, they encounter a {{p|Groudon}} who guards the area. Upon its defeat, they find out that it was an illusion created by Uxie. Upon asking a question, Uxie confirms that he had no involvement with the amnesia, and never even came close to the two of them. He then shows the two, along with the guild members, a geyser filled with {{p|Volbeat}} and {{p|Illumise}}. He lets them go, warning them to keep this place a secret. However, some time later, {{mdc|Grovyle|2}} takes down Uxie and steals the Time Gear.

Uxie is mentioned when the player faces off with {{p|Mesprit}} at the end of [[Quicksand Cave]], who says that the two had spoken through telepathy. Later, with this hint, {{mdc|Dusknoir|2}} is able to infer that Grovyle had not yet stolen the last of the Time Gears, guarded by Azelf.

After {{p|Azelf}} successfully defends his Time Gear from Grovyle, Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf join forces with Dusknoir to set a trap for Grovyle. After Grovyle is captured, Uxie, as well as Mesprit and Azelf, makes a promise that all the Time Gears will be restored to their rightful places.

After the player defeats [[Primal Dialga]], the player's team is allowed to try to defeat a [[level]] 42 Uxie in the Fogbound Lake, where if they win, Uxie will join the player's team.
